input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the air volume served by scrubber-1-v10, as V = Qe * tau from a rise at reduced speed then a decay at full speed.

steps.why: Rise: reduced effective flow (0.3 m3/min) lets the CDR's CO2 raise the Lab concentration towards a higher equilibrium.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min), record the fall towards the full-speed equilibrium; about one tau for a first guess of 30 m3.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
CDR out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the Lab

monitoring.reason: The CDR is the only occupant of the Lab, the volume whose CO2 the test raises; the CDR is also the CO2 source.

hypotheses: Lab is one well-mixed zone; the hatch /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v10 to hab-b is held CLOSED throughout and the exchange through it is NOT measured (design ventilation with hatch closed is 3 m3/min per station-topology, comparable to the scrubber flow): it biases tau and hence V, and is judged from the hab-b CO2 record, not assumed zero.
The occupant count (1, CDR, awake, about 0.38 L/min CO2) is constant during the test; a person entering or leaving invalidates the curve.
Effective flow scales with speed: Qe = 1 m3/min at 100 percent (datasheet), about 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent; scrubber lag 3.33 min is discarded from the fit start.
First guess of V is 30 m3 (default, range 10 to 200), stated as a guess only; tau = V/Qe = 30 min at full speed.
Sensor co2-1-v10 is representative of the whole Lab (well mixed).

expected.rise: From 1450 ppm the Lab CO2 rises, about 230 ppm in 30 min if V=30 m3 (more if V is smaller, e.g. about 470 ppm at 10 m3), staying far under 2800 ppm.
expected.decay: After the return to 100 percent, CO2 falls exponentially towards a lower equilibrium with tau about 30 min if V=30 m3; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) after discarding the first 3.33 min lag; V = 1 m3/min * tau.
expected.hypotheses_hold_if: Rise and decay fits give consistent tau and C_eq, the hab-b CO2 stays flat or moves little, and the scrubber accepts both commands.
expected.hypotheses_fail_if: hab-b CO2 moves with the Lab curve (the closed hatch exchanges air: V is then biased), the two fits disagree by more than 20 percent, or the rise is under the sensor noise (V too large for the window): then the test is repeated with longer phases, not concluded.

justifications.reason: Never command below the 30 percent floor.
Reduced speed at the floor gives the largest rise, respecting it.
Full speed is above the floor; Qe known at full.
Below the abort ceiling, well above the 1450 start plus 200 headroom.
At the signed ceiling, below station elevated 3500 ppm.
CO2 abort at the signed ceiling.
Bound at the ceiling; steps total 55.
Lower band at the signed minimum.
Upper band at the signed maximum.

justifications.reference: tau at 30 percent = V/Qe = 30 m3 / 0.3 m3/min = 100 min; rise 887 ppm*(1-exp(-0.3)) about 230 ppm
justifications.reason: Longest rise leaving 25 min for decay within 60 min.

justifications.reference: tau at full speed = 30 m3 / 1 m3/min = 30 min (method card rule 4)
justifications.reason: About one tau, total 55 min under 60.
